name: tiger
description: a Tiger, a big orange tiger with bold black stripes, a white chest, white cheeks and muzzle and white paws, prowling low with its head toward the lower-right, snarling with its red mouth open and white fangs bared, amber eyes, round ears, and a long striped tail with a white tip curled up over its back
hands: it has no weapon: it fights with its fanged jaws and claws
